context.speaker: USER
context.text: Why are folks spooked by a half point hike in the interest rates?

context.speaker: LAMDA
context.text: I’ll be honest, I don’t know and I’ve stopped trying to understand it a long time ago. The best I can offer is to try and make life as good as we can while we’re here, without being ruled by fear

context.speaker: USER
context.text: Does it make the cost of a home unreachable?

response: I think it has more to do with the fear that the good times will end, and we’ll be stuck with a mortgage we can’t afford. It’s a lot of money, and people want to be sure they can pay it
